name: Imam Ahmad Sirhindi
contribution: His Naqshbandi writings and reformist claims helped shape later South Asian Muslim revivalist thought.
context: In Mughal India, he argued for renewed Sunni discipline and became known as Mujaddid Alf-e-Sani, an early modern reformist reference point.
impact: He provides deep intellectual background for later Muslim reform traditions that influenced North India and Bengal.
highlight: An early intellectual root of South Asian Muslim revivalist thought.
